neighbours.label: the preposition that introduces the topic of an advice/help/request noun (advice on, instructions on, assistance in)
fire: The firm is often hired to give advice on planning rules for new homes.
For instructions on how to reset the router, see the back of the box.
The clinic gives families guidance about caring for older relatives.
Many students asked for help in choosing the right courses.
Please send any questions on the new policy to the main office.
The leaflet offers tips on saving energy during the winter months.
The charity provides support in finding stable housing for young people.
She wrote to the council with a request for information about the project.
quiet: The firm is often hired to build homes on land near the river.
For the router, look at the label on the back of the box.
The clinic is open for families who live in the older district.
Many students sat in the hall choosing between the courses.
Please leave any parcels on the desk in the main office.
The leaflet sits on the table during the winter months.
The charity is based in a small building near the station.
She wrote to the council from her house in the north of town.

notes: ' on' x12, ' in' x10, ' about' x4 after advice/instructions/request/assistance nouns.
